27. INDIVIDUAL PISTON OPERATION INSPECTION
Check for the sound of operation while applying com-
pressed air into the oil holes indicated in the illustration.
HINT: When inspecting the O/D direct clutch, check with
the C0 accumulator piston hole closed.
If there is no noise, disassemble and check the installa-
tion condition of the parts.
(1) Direct clutch
(2) Forward clutch
(3) O/D brake
(4) Second coast brake
(5) Second brake
(6) First and reverse brake

(a) Using SST, drive in a new oil seal.
